overview.heading: What one AI agent can handle
overview.intro: These are four capabilities of the same agent, not steps in a fixed order. It works through the tools you already use, so you can start with the one task that costs you the most time.

items.title: Connected tools

workflows.name: Capture enquiries
workflows.goal: Every enquiry is recorded and answered quickly, in your tone, without anyone copying details by hand.
workflows.trigger: A new message from your website form, email inbox, Instagram DM or WhatsApp Business.
steps: Read the message and pull out the name, contact details and request.
Create or update the contact in your CRM and tag where it came from.
Draft a reply in your tone, using your price list or FAQ.
Send the draft to you, and send it to the customer only after you approve.
tools: HubSpot, Zoho CRM, Pipedrive or a Google Sheet
Gmail or Outlook, with ChatGPT or Claude
workflows.approval: every reply stays a draft until you approve it. Nothing reaches a customer without you.
workflows.label: Capability 01

workflows.name: Follow up on time
workflows.goal: No lead or quote is forgotten, and follow-ups go out on a rhythm you choose.
workflows.trigger: A lead hasn’t replied, or a quote is still open, after the days you set (for example day 1, 3 and 7).
steps: Check the CRM each morning for leads that are due.
Remind you, or whoever owns the lead, with the context in one message.
Send a follow-up from your pre-approved templates.
Mark the lead “needs attention” if there is still no reply after the last step.
tools: your CRM’s built-in follow-ups, or Make, Zapier or n8n
workflows.approval: only messages you approved in advance go out automatically. Anything unusual comes back to you.
workflows.label: Capability 02

workflows.name: Process documents
workflows.goal: Key details are read, checked and filed for you, ready for a person to confirm.
workflows.trigger: An invoice, purchase order, contract or form arrives by email or lands in a shared folder.
steps: Read the document and extract the key fields: supplier, number, amount and due date.
Check them against what you expect, such as a matching purchase order.
Write a short summary and save the fields to your sheet or accounting tool.
Queue it for a teammate to check before anything is paid or signed.
tools: Google Sheets, Excel, Zoho Books, Xero or QuickBooks
workflows.approval: the AI prepares and a person checks. Mismatches are flagged, never silently fixed.
workflows.label: Capability 03

workflows.name: Keep teams updated
workflows.goal: The right people hear about changes as they happen, so nobody has to chase for an update.
workflows.trigger: A task or order changes status: started, done, delayed or blocked.
steps: Detect the status change in your task tool or CRM.
Write a one-line summary of what changed and what happens next.
Send it only to the people it concerns: sales, operations or finance.
Post a short daily digest of everything that moved.
tools: Slack, Microsoft Teams, WhatsApp groups or email
workflows.approval: you decide who hears about what. Sensitive updates can always wait for a person.
